scripts.cap:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: vite build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:apk:debug: vite build && npx cap sync android && chmod +x ./android/gradlew && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: vite build && npx cap sync android && chmod +x ./android/gradlew && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease
scripts.build:admin: vite build --config Admin/vite.config.ts && mkdir -p Admin/android/app/src/main/assets/public && cp -r Admin/dist/* Admin/android/app/src/main/assets/public/
scripts.android:admin:apk:debug: npm run build:admin && chmod +x ./Admin/android/gradlew && ./Admin/android/gradlew -p Admin/android assembleDebug
scripts.android:admin:apk:release: npm run build:admin && chmod +x ./Admin/android/gradlew && ./Admin/android/gradlew -p Admin/android assembleRelease
